description: Uderia itself as a tool — the agent finds and calls the platform's own operations as the user, through the same routes and checks as any client. Its roles decide what it reaches; a change waits for a person where it must. Off until an owner turns it on.

tool_definition.name: TDA_Platform
tool_definition.description: Uderia's own operations — the user's agents and their configuration, and more as the platform describes them. 'find' with a few words returns the operations that could do it, each with its arguments and whether you may call it; 'call' runs one by its op id with its arguments, as the user. Never invent an op id or an argument: 'find' first. An operation marked callable:false is a person's act or not offered to agents — tell the user what it is, never retry it. 'ask' puts a question to another of the user's agents and returns its answer — only an agent its owner lists, only where the deployment allows asking.

query.description: find: what you want to see or do, in a few words (e.g. 'my agents', 'an agent's components')

op.description: call: the operation's id, exactly as 'find' returned it (e.g. 'profiles.list')

args.description: call: the operation's arguments by name, as 'find' listed them (path, query and body alike)

fields.description: call: keep only these keys of every record in the answer (e.g. ['tag', 'name']) — use it when an answer is long

agent.description: ask: the agent to ask, by its @TAG

question.description: ask: the question for that agent, complete in itself — it does not see this conversation

intensity_tooltips.medium: Use TDA_Platform when the user asks about their agents or the platform itself
intensity_tooltips.heavy: Check the platform's own state before answering questions about it
